description: 100 high-difficulty Chinese and Chinese-English code-understanding cases. Every question is newly written, intentionally noisy or internally conflicted, and grounded in the offline fixture.

generation_contract.external_content_policy: Research sources provide discourse patterns only; no external question is copied and all expected evidence is local.

research_basis.source: GitHub issue search: uncertain bug vs expected behavior
research_basis.pattern: Uncertain bug classification, partial context, contradictory observations and apologetic self-correction.
Nested defaults and aliases create competing precedence hypotheses; the reporter cannot yet pin down whether behavior is surprising or wrong.
Restart timing, logs, scheduled behavior and an uncertain interpretation are mixed into one causal report.
Two fields contradict each other while the reporter explicitly allows that the assumed invariant may be wrong.
A plausible-but-wrong retrieval result leads to an incorrect causal theory; scope mismatch is the real issue.

research_basis.source: V2EX Python and Q&A topic feeds
research_basis.pattern: Colloquial requests often omit environment details, include irrelevant background, repeat themselves and ask several goals only at the end.

research_basis.source: Zhihu search: Python errors are hard to understand
research_basis.pattern: Chinese novice questions commonly provide screenshots or fragments, confuse environment with logic, contain typos and revise the premise after more context appears.
